thread_title: S. psittacina shapely red heads  Stone Co, MS, FL
breadcrumb: S. psittacina shapely red heads  Stone Co, MS, FL

posts.body_html:
This clone might be a giant, but it's still too early to tell if it will size up. It was selected out of the population because of its shapely, colorful red heads! There is a little bit of white that contrasts with the red heads, making the color overall even more appealing!
